name: Brianne Wakefield
bottom_line: A short biography page for a first-time candidate. Her county trafficking subcommittee role is reported in local press; the other details rest on the campaign's word.
findings: Her role chairing the Suffolk County Women's Advisory Commission's Human and Sex Trafficking Subcommittee is reported by the Messenger (May 2026), which quotes her.
Church founding, arts board service and family details have no independent record.
page_issues: No dates, sources or specifics behind the "proven record of service."
